name: CodeBlockBody
description: Inner code panel. Render the complete pre and code as children. A long line scrolls inside the `pre`, so the body makes it a named region the keyboard can reach: Safari doesn't focus a scroller on its own.

props.name: codeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the scrolling code region, such as "ts code".
